Pre-Inference Privacy Dry-Run Audit for Research Data Frames

Source: R/workflow.R
pii_audit_dataframe.Rd

Performs a non-destructive pre-run PII inspection across a data frame text column before calling airgap_extract(). Produces aggregate per-entity counts, row coverage metrics, high-PII-density row flags, HIPAA Safe Harbor advisories, Unicode obfuscation warnings, and strictly redacted preview snippets containing zero raw sensitive values.

Usage

pii_audit_dataframe(
  data,
  text_col,
  config = pii_config(),
  id_col = NULL,
  high_density_threshold = 3L,
  preview_n = 5L,
  preview_chars = 120L
)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing text rows to audit.

text_col

Character scalar name of the text column in data.

config

An pii_config() configuration object.

id_col

Optional character scalar column name for row identifiers.

high_density_threshold

Positive integer minimum entity count in a single row to flag as high-PII-density (default 3L).

preview_n

Non-negative integer number of redacted preview snippets to include (default 5L).

preview_chars

Positive integer maximum preview snippet length (default 120L).

Value

An S3 object of class "airgap_pii_audit" containing report (airgap_privacy_report), row_summary (tibble), high_density_rows (character vector of row IDs), obfuscated_rows (integer count), warnings (character vector), and masked_previews (tibble with zero raw PII).

Examples

data("synthetic_notes", package = "airgapllm")
aud <- pii_audit_dataframe(synthetic_notes, "note_text", id_col = "note_id")
aud
#> <airgap_pii_audit> (pre-inference privacy dry-run; zero raw PII)
#>   Rows scanned:        16
#>   Rows with PII:       12 (75%)
#>   Total PII spans:     36
#>   High-density rows:   7 (>= 3 entities)
#>   Unicode-normalized:  0 row(s)
#>   Entity breakdown:
#>     - age_over_89: 3 (2 rows, 12.5%)
#>     - date: 6 (6 rows, 37.5%)
#>     - email: 3 (3 rows, 18.75%)
#>     - ip_address: 1 (1 rows, 6.25%)
#>     - mrn_id: 4 (4 rows, 25%)
#>     - person_name: 8 (6 rows, 37.5%)
#>     - phone: 4 (4 rows, 25%)
#>     - ssn: 1 (1 rows, 6.25%)
#>     - street_address: 2 (2 rows, 12.5%)
#>     - zip_code: 4 (4 rows, 25%)
#>   Advisories:
#>     [!] 7 row(s) exceed high-PII-density threshold (>= 3 entities/row); review custom_dictionary coverage before inference.
#>     [!] HIPAA Safe Harbor alert: 3 age > 89 reference(s) detected and scheduled for redaction.
#>     [!] HIPAA Safe Harbor alert: 4 geographic ZIP code / restricted 3-digit prefix span(s) detected.
#>     [!] High-sensitivity identifier alert: 1 SSN pattern(s) detected.
